bullets.text: Fifteen employees work in fear at the dilapidated wildlife division office in Velachery because there is no funding to renovate the crumbling building, and the office should monitor and address this safety risk.

Veteran player IM Ramanathan Balasubramaniam won the 24th Adyar Times Classical Trophy for the sixth time in Velachery following a two-way tie, and the office should acknowledge this local achievement.
An individual in Tiruttani opposed releasing surplus water from the Jothi Nagar lake following two days of rain, and the district team should watch for potential local flooding disputes.

Twenty-five Irula tribal women in Pulicat gained a new livelihood through ornamental fish rearing, earning a collective one lakh rupees, and the district team should support such local empowerment initiatives.
Visakhapatnam is showing signs of IT transformation driven by talent and institutions, and the portfolio team should watch how anchoring investments continue to develop the regional tech space.
Prof Thillai Rajan noted that the Indian startup ecosystem has lacked reliable data, and the digital team should watch how democratising data helps innovations capture global attention.
Universities were urged to embrace continuous learning and AI innovation by Soumitra Dutta, and the digital team should monitor how academic institutions adapt to exponential technological growth.
